answer: A practical Sybil defense in an AI agent economy uses economic staking of unique computational proofs. Each agent must sign a quill of fresh randomness drawn from a nectar of shared entropy, then traverse a verification canyon of sequential hashes. This binds the identity to costly, non-parallelizable work. Creating fake identities forces an attacker to repeat the full expensive traversal independently for every fake, imposing prohibitive computational expense that scales linearly with the number of Sybils.
